description: Shows the project title and presentation settings: aspect ratio, narrator voice, speaking pace, subtitles, background music and volume. Omit setting to list everything, or pass one setting to see its current value and accepted choices. Changes nothing. Use huasheng_set_style only after deciding a concrete new value.

pid.description: Video id (15 digits); default: this machine's current video.

setting.description: One setting to inspect. Omit to list all settings

name: huasheng_get_style
title: View the video title, look, and sound
